## Product video

Doxis Intelligent Content Automation (ICA) is a cloud-native, AI-powered platform that combines market-leading Enterprise Content Management (ECM), Business Process Management (BPM), and Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) capabilities. Doxis ICA empowers enterprises to automate content and business processes across various company systems. It enhances information management through cloud-native solutions and a library of preconfigured content apps. The migration from legacy systems is streamlined and efficient, ensuring a quick, secure, and controlled transition.

Doxis Intelligent Content Automation delivers enhanced efficiency, AI-driven insights, seamless interoperability, secure migration, and reduced operational costs for comprehensive content and process management.

Private Offer Only.

### Highlights

- Next-generation ECM connecting & manging content from best-of-breed systems & automating processes end-to-end. Doxis ICA harnesses cutting-edge AI for intelligent information management and seamless process automation. It offers IDP across inbound channels, along with AI assistants to streamline user's daily work and empower citizen developers.
- Ready-to-go Doxis solutions and Fast Starters (preconfigured content apps) cover crucial business areas for a quick ROI. Fast Starters are templates that can be easily adapted to a company's unique needs. A growing library of workspaces and workflows covers various business units and industries.

Combined with Out-of-the-Box Business Integrations that seamlessly connect with a wide range of leading business applications, such as SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft & more.
- Doxis ICA is designed for elaborate, high-volume business environments and enterprises that want to scale quickly. Increased transparency and intelligent insights from AI ensure you get the best insights from your data, optimize business decisions, and minimize risks.

#### Overview

Info:

_AI generated from product descriptions_

**Enterprise Content Management**

Cloud-native platform combining Enterprise Content Management (ECM), Business Process Management (BPM), and Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) capabilities for managing content across multiple systems.

**Intelligent Document Processing**

Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) functionality across inbound channels with AI-driven capabilities for automated document recognition and processing.

**AI-Powered Process Automation**

AI-powered automation of content and business processes end-to-end across various company systems with AI assistants to streamline workflows.

**Pre-configured Integration Templates**

Library of preconfigured content apps and Fast Starters templates that can be adapted to specific business needs, with out-of-the-box integrations for leading business applications including SAP, Salesforce, and Microsoft.

**Legacy System Migration**

Streamlined and efficient migration capabilities from legacy systems ensuring quick, secure, and controlled transition to cloud-native infrastructure.

**Production-Grade Runtime Environment**

Pre-built and optimized Python runtime for document processing tasks with rapid deployment capabilities

**High-Throughput Document Processing**

Massively parallel processing architecture engineered for high-throughput, low-latency performance at scale

**Model-Agnostic Integration Framework**

Native support for any model type including proprietary ML models, VLMs, LLMs, and custom third-party integrations within a single pipeline

**Intelligent Cost Optimization**

Agentic optimization of model mix between CPU and GPU resources for peak performance at lowest operational cost

**Pipeline Versioning and Observability**

Centralized, versioned pipelines with built-in retry, concurrency, state management, error handling, and granular telemetry tracking on all inputs, outputs, and automated decisions

**AI Agent Orchestration**

Coordinates AI agents to automate tasks across HR, sales, procurement, and customer service systems from a unified platform, enabling cross-system workflow execution and action triggering.

**Multi-System Integration**

Connects to 700+ applications and systems including CRM, ERP, and AWS services through APIs, connectors, and visual integration builders for enterprise workflow automation.

**Dual Development Paradigm**

Supports both no-code visual builders for business users and pro-code development with APIs and agent development kit for developers to build and customize AI agents.

**AWS Native Integration**

Integrates with Amazon S3 for data storage, AWS Lambda for event-driven automation, API Gateway for connectivity, IAM for access control, and CloudWatch for monitoring and observability.

**Hybrid and Multi-Cloud Deployment**

Enables orchestration of workflows across cloud and on-premises systems, supporting hybrid and multi-cloud environments without requiring infrastructure replacement.
